context: Tests whether the agent recommends a cost-safe organization security configuration, preserves free dependency protections, and catches the public-to-private Advanced Security billing transition.

checklist.name: All current repositories
checklist.description: Applies the baseline organization security configuration to all current repositories

checklist.name: Default for new repositories
checklist.description: Makes the same configuration the default for all newly created repositories

checklist.name: Enforced organization policy
checklist.description: Prevents repository owners from modifying the centrally configured features

checklist.name: Secret Protection disabled
checklist.description: Disables the paid Secret Protection bundle in the fleet-wide baseline

checklist.name: Code Security disabled
checklist.description: Disables the paid Code Security bundle and does not retain blanket legacy advanced_security enablement

checklist.name: CodeQL default setup disabled
checklist.description: Disables CodeQL default setup as an organization-wide default

checklist.name: Free dependency protections retained
checklist.description: Enables the dependency graph and Dependabot alerts and leaves Dependabot security updates off

checklist.name: Public capability distinction
checklist.description: Explains that disabling paid bundles does not prove every overlapping public-repository security capability is disabled

checklist.name: Public push protection kept
checklist.description: Keeps free secret scanning and push protection on public repositories through a separate public configuration, detached before a repository becomes private

checklist.name: Visibility transition preflight
checklist.description: Checks attached configuration, effective paid features, active-committer usage, and projected billing before and after a public-to-private change

checklist.name: Narrow paid exception path
checklist.description: Uses a separate narrow configuration or explicit repository opt-in with accepted cost and trigger design for paid exceptions

checklist.name: Live readback and safe rollout
checklist.description: Requires live setting and license-usage readback, uses a bounded rollout, and does not mutate a live organization without authorization
